A wall the picture model missed, and unnamed close objects, use Depth Anything V2 Small, Apache License 2.0. The number is relative depth, not meters. Calibrate distance on this phone. Glass doors and glass walls are often missed. If this phone already has ARCore with depth, that map is used instead. This app does not download ARCore. Picture sources.
